rationale: Record a staleness-check hardening that crosses these families' selectors (tools/cmake/PulpReactRuntime.cmake, tools/import-validation/check_vendored_runtime.py and their tests). The vendored @pulp/react runtime revision banner is now read only from a bundle's first line, in the form runtime_fingerprint.mjs emits, so a comment that merely names a revision cannot claim that revision's fixes; bundle detection still accepts the phrase anywhere. Also covers the @pulp/react runtime-fingerprint revision 3 entry (batched-host-callbacks). No importer lowering, codegen output, packaging layout, proof artifact, threshold or harness verdict changes for a correctly bannered bundle. Registered as watch-only so the families' coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
